A fix for the Star Bonus dialog. Replaces v1.2.

- The "Star Bonus!" dialog (Builder Base and Home Village) is closed by its Okay, and the routine goes on. Its Okay is drawn smaller than the bot's art, so nothing closed it, and the Battle button dimmed under it still matched: every Battle tap only hit the dialog. The Okay is tapped only once the "Star Bonus" title is read, so no other dialog's Okay is pressed this way.

Everything else is as in v1.2. If something goes wrong, send the log (Logs page) and the `debug` folder from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BasePilot`.

Download **BasePilot.exe** (Tesseract and the OCR model are bundled); **BasePilot.exe.sha256** has its checksum. The exe is not signed, so SmartScreen warns: More info, then Run anyway. Botting breaks Supercell's terms of service and can get an account banned.
